name: Divine Counterspell
body:
You have discovered that your divine connection allows you the power to undo magic.

Prerequisite(s): Spellcraft 5 ranks, channel energy or lay on hands 3d6.

Benefit: You may spend two uses of channel energy or lay on hands to cast dispel magic with a caster level equal to your character level. When your channel energy or lay on hands class feature reaches 6d6 you may cast greater dispel magic instead.
